title: eat shit & die 135
author: bpatrick
hoverText: I wish this were how it worked.
body: Another episode with Allison. I was trying to come up with a way to show more characterization with short little one-off episodes in ESAD. I came up with this chronologically out of order approach; giving small insights to the larger picture with little stories that can stand on their own. I hope it works out. I’ve got the character of Allison and her life all mapped out in my head. I just hope I can make it fun to find out about.
